== English errata comparison sources ==
The Rules Committee published the replacement on 16 February 2015 and stated that it was effective immediately. The 2022 Advanced Rulebook v3.28 (PDF page 121) and the 2023 Appendix A (page 126) print the same replacement. The Revised Dagobah face says “reshuffle” and retains the original count-first wording. The Reflections Gold cards remain separate printings.
